# rd-runtime-missing: confirmed 2026-11-12 on 1.11.240
needs | f4rd-runtime | Data\F4SE\Plugins\f4rd-runtime.bin | warning | Plugins built on CommonLibF4RD need the Runtime Database mod (Nexus 108394). Install it, or those plugins show an error box and stop.

# enb-community-shaders: confirmed 2026-11-12 on 1.11.240
conflict | Data\F4SE\Plugins\FO4CommunityShaders.dll | {ENB} | warning | An ENB and Fallout 4 Community Shaders are both installed. In our testing ENB post-processing did not apply until Community Shaders was disabled. Use one or the other.

# old-mainmenu-swf: confirmed 2026-11-12 on 1.11.240
oldfile@AE | Data\Interface\MainMenu.swf | 2024-04-25 | problem | It replaces the game's main menu and was made before the Next-Gen/Anniversary updates. Old main menu files crash the game at the main menu on 1.11.x (seen with three different mods). Disable the mod that provides it; with Vortex, check that no other mod provides the same file.

# old-fontconfig: confirmed 2026-11-12 on 1.11.240
oldfile@NG,AE | Data\Interface\FontConfig.txt | 2024-04-25 | warning | It replaces the game's font list and was made before the Next-Gen/Anniversary updates. An old font list can turn UI text into boxes. If you see boxes, disable the mod that provides it.

# pcl-refused: confirmed 2026-11-12 on 1.11.240
dll@AE | PapyrusCommonLibrary.dll | refused | warning | Papyrus Common Library is a framework other mods call. An Anniversary version exists (Papyrus Common Library AE, Nexus 106621); scripts that call it fail until it runs.

# xdi-refused: confirmed 2026-11-12 on 1.11.240
dll@NG,AE | XDI.dll | refused | warning | Extended Dialogue Interface (XDI) is not running. Old XDI builds do not load on F4SE 0.7.x; in our test a fresh install of the current XDI file fixed dialogue errors.

# wsfw-old-gen-replacers: confirmed 2026-11-13 on 1.11.240
dll@NG,AE | wsfw_identifier.dll | refused | warning | Workshop Framework's F4SE plugin is not running. On Next-Gen and Anniversary, the "Old-Gen Replacers" file for Workshop Framework replaces it with an Old-Gen build that F4SE 0.7.x skips. Disable "Workshop Framework - Old-Gen Replacers" so the main file's plugin is used. In our test this made it load.

# addictol-daytripper: confirmed 2026-11-14 on 1.11.240
conflict | Data\F4SE\Plugins\Daytripper4.dll | Data\F4SE\Plugins\Addictol.dll | warning | Addictol and Daytripper 4 are both installed. Addictol shows an error and shuts itself down while Daytripper4.dll is present. Disable Daytripper 4 (Addictol covers the same engine fixes).

# rustyfacefix-og-only: confirmed 2026-11-14 on 1.11.240
dll@NG,AE | RustyFaceFix.dll | refused | warning | Rusty Face Fix 2.0.x is for Old-Gen 1.10.163 only, so this DLL does not run and brown faces after loading a save may come back. The mod page's Legacy file v1.2.1 says it works on all game versions and needs no DLL; use that instead.

# sup-f4se-refused: confirmed 2026-11-14 on 1.11.240
dll | SUP_F4SE.dll | refused | warning | SUP F4SE (last update March 2024) does not run on this game version. Mods that call it, such as Universal Disassembler (its Scrap Machine), log "Unbound native function GetSUPF4SEVersion" in the Papyrus log and lose that feature.

# lighthouse-refused: confirmed 2026-11-14 on 1.11.240
